correctness.rationale: Exact Euclidean squared distances yield six affine/constant functions with six positive crossing parameters. Thirteen possible state complexes are exhaustively identified. Classical clique-power results and cap-and-annulus homotopy pushouts determine stage homotopy; exact relative collapses of 12,24,60 pairs and primitive cap/loop maps determine integral persistence. A standard-library checker recomputes all finite face counts, independent integer boundary reductions and simple connectivity for two exceptional stages. The all-real parameter claim rests on symbolic comparisons.

value.rationale: Natural one-parameter deformation of a symmetric twelve-point polyhedron. Thirteen realizable simplicial states, six exact wall heights and seven open geometric regimes, a sharp terminal H5 versus H3 transition, and primitive integral persistence maps answer a geometric-topological stability question not captured by stage-wise homotopy data. Finite complexity does not trivialize the exact cross-height classification.
